title: jasminum fluminense subsp. gratissimum
intro: Jasminum fluminense subsp. gratissimum, commonly known as Brazilian star jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to the southeastern regions of Brazil. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Brazilian star jasmine include its ability to soothe anxiety and stress, as well as its potential in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Brazilian star jasmine contribute to its therapeutic actions, which are also influenced by its essential oil, which contains compounds like linalool and geraniol.
